name: Moose Knuckles
why: Montreal-designed down parkas from 2009 with the crossed-knuckle badge, made abroad; four US stores and three outlets, owned by Cathay Capital with Bosideng.
origin: Founded in 2009 in Canada (site: "founded Moose Knuckles Canada in 2009"; Montreal is named as the design base, but no founding city is stated) by Noah Stern and Ayal Twik (FashionUnited, 9 Oct 2024).

craft_evidence.owned: claimed, not evidenced: Craftsmanship page says the company "currently operates from three factories" in Canada with 200+ staff and names six workers, but gives no factory name or address; 0 of 96 men's articles read say Made in Canada (all say Vietnam, China or Peru)
craft_evidence.makers: NONE (no product page names a factory or maker)
craft_evidence.mills: NONE (no cloth or yarn mill named; YKK zippers named on the Product Knowledge page are hardware)
craft_evidence.madein: 100 (96 of 96 men's articles state the country: China 50, Vietnam 33, Peru 13; none Canada)
craft_evidence.heritage: dated, not placed: "Since 1921, our family has been protecting Canadians from the cold" and brand founded 2009 (Brand History); no founding city stated on the site
craft_evidence.process: partly: Craftsmanship page says an average coat takes 74 operations and 90 craftspeople, with captioned workroom photos (hood fur trim, topstitching, zipper check); Product Knowledge describes the coated 74/26 shell and down fill-power test
craft_evidence.reasoning: Every men's product page states a country of making, but none names a maker or mill, and all 96 articles read say China, Vietnam or Peru. The Craftsmanship page claims three Canadian factories and names staff, but gives no factory name or place and contradicts the current range, so it is a claim, not evidence. The heritage line ("since 1921") is dated but not placed. 2, with 3 arguable only if the Canadian factories can be shown to make current product.

ownership.owner: Cathay Capital (private equity) majority owner since 2019; Bosideng took a stake of more than 30% in 2024, when founders Noah Stern and Ayal Twik exited as shareholders (FashionUnited, 9 Oct 2024 and 6 Oct 2026)
